locations.note: Seven months after the outbreak, the Agent answers a distress call from Washington and fights the Hyenas, the Outcasts, the True Sons and later Black Tusk across the collapsing capital.
The Division's base in Washington; the Agent arrives to help the JTF beat off a Hyena attack on it, and at the end stops Black Tusk's missile strike on it.
The True Sons hold the Capitol, where President Ellis's briefcase for the antivirals is kept; the Agent storms it as one of the faction strongholds.
The Outcasts, survivors of the JTF quarantine zone on the island, hold it against the Division, and the Agent fights through their stronghold.
The Agent fights through the True Sons holding the American History Museum and takes down their commander, Captain Briggs.
The Agent investigates True Sons activity at the Air & Space Museum and defeats their Lieutenant Kelly.
The Agent helps the Campus settlement take the Lincoln Memorial from the True Sons and their commander Major Ashford.
The Agent raids Black Tusk's stronghold at the Tidal Basin, takes back the antivirals and stops the missile strike on the White House.
In the Pentagon: The Last Castle episode, the Agent sabotages Black Tusk's drilling down to the DARPA labs under the Pentagon and seizes the bioreactor they came for.
In the Coney Island: The Hunt episode, the Agent tracks the virologist Vitaly Tchernenko to the ruined amusement park, where Black Tusk is holding him, and gets him out.
In Warlords of New York, the Agent finds the Division and JTF base at City Hall devastated by Keener's Eclipse virus.
Battery Park is the base of one of Keener's four rogue-agent warlords, whom the Agent hunts down in Warlords of New York.
Another of Keener's warlords operates from the New York Stock Exchange until the Agent eliminates them.
The Agent takes a ferry to Liberty Island, fights through Black Tusk to Keener in the Statue of Liberty Museum, destroys the missile meant to spread Eclipse over Manhattan and mortally wounds him.
In Warlords of New York, the rogue agent Theo Parnell makes his last stand in the Tombs, where the Agent hunts him down.
